title: Engineer Cleared, Worker Honored, Sidewalk Permit
summary:
*   Cleared an Assistant City Engineer of "car ticket fraud" allegations from 1913, finding it was a case of mistaken identity and fully restoring his reputation.
*   Approved the payment of funeral expenses for Earnest Dunaway, a Water, Light and Power Department employee who died while on duty.
*   Granted a temporary, revocable permit to E. M. Scarbrough & Sons to excavate under the sidewalk on Congress Avenue.

..gular meeting of the City Council: Austin, Texas, May 13, 1915.
Hon F W Wooldridge, Mayor Presiding: Roll called : Present Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Absent none: The minutes of the last regular and
subsequent recessed meetings were read and ad pted:
Reports of City Officers:
The Mayor laid before the Council the reports of the Asst City Clerk, the Supt of Streets
and the City Sexton, which were read and ordered filed: The Mayor laid before the Council
the followng resolution : Whereas, on the 21st day of June 1913, the City Council acting
upon information then in its possession ,passed the followinh resolution : • Be it
resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin Texas : That , after a full hearing of
the facts in the case, the City Council completely Resolution.
J. A. Guissinger
exhonerates J A Guissinger, Assistant City Engineer ,from any intent of wrong doing in
connection with a supposed request for an additional book of car tickets alleged to have
been made of Jno Miller , Clerk in the engineering department , the 19th day of June
1913", and Whereas, since that date, on to-wit, this day, conclusive evidence has been
submitted to the City Council that J A Guissinger did not even ask for an extra book of
street car tickets at all; nor was he in anyway identified with said alleged transaction
except to have been present ; and Whereas, from the evidence submitted in this case the
entire transaction appears so far as the said J A Guissinger is concerned , to have been a
case of mistaken identity.
Now, therefore,
Be it resolved by the City Council of Austin, Texas: That no blemish, even a stigma
attached to the name, life or conduct or service to the City of Austin while he was in its
employ as Assistant City Engineer, and that he left the employ of the City Council not
only with our respect, but with the confidence of the head of the engineering department,
with the respect , confidence and good will of the individuals of this Council .
The resolution was adopted by the City Council .
Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell No,
Approved, A P Wooldridge
